name: dsh-image-compare
description: Paginated image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: open a set of images in one pageable viewer, zoom and pan each image independently, reorder them by dragging the filmstrip, and browse the session workspace from inside the panel.

comment.runtime: The host half imports @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools and uses the `fs`, `tools` and `attachments` services; the client half requires only `react`, which every harness shell preloads. Every one of those is supplied by the running profile, so this package deliberately declares NO dependencies: an installed copy must never ship its own copy of a dsh framework package next to the host's.
comment.tests: test/host.test.mjs resolves the locally stubbed @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools from the workspace node_modules; test/client.dom.mjs needs react, react-dom and jsdom, installed on demand with `node <pnpm> add -D react@18.2.0 react-dom@18.2.0 jsdom`.
